title: Template (no values): copy, fill in from the customer specification, verify

elements.name: Point on a vertical plane facing the vehicle

notes: All numeric values are null on purpose. Units: metres and lux. Vehicle frame: x forward, y right, z up, origin on the ground below the vehicle front centre. point.plane: "road" (horizontal, z should be 0), "vertical" (plane facing the vehicle) or { "normal": [nx, ny, nz] }. reach.line: vehicle-axis, lane-centre, lane-left-edge or lane-right-edge. reach and width also accept "max".
